title: Stake the Claim
description: One tile of a picture. Every quest in this chapter is: forty-six nodes on a
48-pixel grid, arranged so that the canvas draws a heart around them.
The chapter is linear, so nothing here declares a dependency -- the order of the
chapter's list is the progression, and it is also the order the picture fills
in. This is the first tile, at the top of the right lobe.
